entries.summary: Wrote and self-published six mathematics titles (First Editions, 2026): bilingual English–Khmer materials for Cambodian students, from Grade 6 practice books through Bac II exam preparation — roughly 980 pages in total.

contributions.text: Four graded workbooks: the *Grade 6 Mathematics Exercise Book* (520 original questions in six levels across twenty chapters, 197 pages) with its full worked-answer companion (227 pages), and the *Grade 7 Mathematics Exercise Book* (572 questions following the Ministry of Education textbook, 115 pages) with its answer book giving every question a full worked solution (205 pages).

A bilingual *English–Khmer Mathematics Dictionary* for Grade 6 (229 pages), and a Khmer worked-solutions booklet on the exponential function written in Bac II national-exam format. The book PDFs are held privately; the five book covers are shown below.
